newsitem.title: USA: True North combines TN Tech, Modem Media.
newsitem.headline: True North combines TN Tech, Modem Media.

text.p: True North Communications Inc, parent of Foote, Cone & Belding, said Thursday its board approved combining operations of the company's digital marketing communications unit, TN Technologies, with Modem Media Advertising LP.
Modem Media, based in Westport, Conn., a digital communications company, will become a unit of TN Technologies.
In a related move, True North said its board approved proceeding with an initial public offering of the combined operations of TN Technologies and Modem Media.

The combined TN Technologies intends to file registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed initial public offering of shares of its Class A common. The offering will be made by prospectus.

"When we reported last year's strong results, we said an initial public offering for TN Technologies would be among the strategic opportunities True North would consider in 1996 as part of our commitment to further increase shareholder value," said True North chairman Bruce Mason in a statement.
Greg Blaine, now chairman and chief executive of TN Technologies, will continue to head the expanded company. Modem Media founder G.M. O'Connell will become president and chief operating officer.

In connection with the combination of TN Technologies and Modem Media, True North Communications said Modem Media will receive $25 million of True North common stock at closing, plus an additional $4 million of True North common upon the initial public offering of TN Technologies.
In addition, Modem Media will retain a substantial minority interest in the new combined entity.
Closing of the transaction is expected in early November.
